title: A list carries its cadence, time, time zone and rule as data
description:
Every subscription list (a Caducus public-audience list) gets settings in the site's data: `cadence` (`each`: a message for every new item; `daily`; `weekly`), `sendAt` and `timeZone` for the periodic ones, the rule (sections, types, tags, a minimum star rating never under three), `requireReviewedSource`, the working document (`story`, an issue Story that is published to the archive, or `delivery`, no archive page), the template, and optionally its own rung. A periodic list is a scheduled agent wake (the schedule trigger); an every-item list is woken by the page-is-live and rating-changed changes. All of them create an Announcement (model `AnnouncementDecision`) and an email Delivery. Nothing about a cadence is in code.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A new list with a cadence and time needs no code or deploy.
- A list's minimum rating cannot be set under three.
- Each cadence produces Announcements and Deliveries of the same shape.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- list-cadence.feature: a weekly list wakes at its local time; a daily list wakes daily; an every-item list reacts to a publish; a rule under three stars is refused; changing the time changes the next send only.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Schedule entries come from the list settings through the schedule reconciler.

**Part of:** Newsletters and subscriptions: weekly, daily and every new item. Slice code N1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
